content: SPDR S&P Select Industry ETFs (sub-sector level, equal-weighted, 0.35% ER): Financial sub-sectors: KBE (Banks), KIE (Insurance), KRE (Regional Banks), KCE (Capital Markets). Healthcare sub-sectors: XBI (Biotech), XPH (Pharma), XHE (Health Care Equipment), XHS (Health Care Services). Technology sub-sectors: XSD (Semiconductors), XSW (Software & Services). Energy sub-sectors: XES (Oil & Gas Equipment & Services), XOP (Oil & Gas E&P, separate from SPDR family). Industrials: XAR (Aerospace & Defense). Consumer Cyclical: XHB (Homebuilders), XRT (Retail). Materials: XME (Metals & Mining). These are distinct from the 11 broad Select Sector SPDRs (XLK, XLF, etc.) and offer finer industry-group exposure.
